html:
SMTO-EVT-0002 — Agent events are disabled

GUID: bed40e7d-0807-4ab7-9adb-b82768adb533
Slug: events-disabled
Domain: EVT · Subsystem: evt

What happened

  • Schedules and reminders are switched off on this SMTO, so it can't create, change or run them, or show their past runs. Turning this off doesn't delete schedules you already saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Schedules. If it says Schedules are disabled, scheduling is switched off for this whole SMTO. This confirms the cause is the on/off switch, not a problem with one schedule.
  2. Ask the person who manages SMTO to turn scheduled events back on and restart the SMTO server. The switch is part of the server's setup, and the scheduler only starts when the server starts with it on.
  3. After the restart, reload Schedules and try your action again. Schedule actions become available again once scheduling is on.

What success looks like

  • Schedules lists your schedules and shows New schedule and Run now again.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't recreate your schedules while scheduling is off; the ones you saved are kept and reappear when it's turned back on.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Event API request was rejected because Agent events are disabled for this installation (settings.agent_events_enabled / AOR_AGENT_EVENTS_ENABLED is false, or the agent_events_enabled runtime control is false).

What this means

  • Event API admission checks the effective Agent-events switch and rejects the requested event mutation, trigger or run-control/read route when disabled. Event, monitor and notification identities have separate owners. Rejected control or missing notification does not cancel an existing task; only authoritative run state establishes its outcome.

Why this can happen

  • Event API admission checks the effective Agent-events switch and rejects the requested event mutation, trigger or run-control/read route when disabled.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the owning configuration and requested route; disabled processing is separate from a missing event.

How to fix it

  • Set AOR_AGENT_EVENTS_ENABLED=true for the server and make sure the agent_events_enabled runtime control is not false, then restart the server (the scheduler worker is only installed at startup when the setting is true). Enabling events does not attach schedules to existing tasks.
  • Enable Agent events in the owning configuration if scheduled events are intended for this installation. Existing tasks do not acquire a new event schedule from this diagnostic.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • An authorized enabled configuration exposes the intended event operation.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Event, monitor and notification identities have separate owners. Rejected control or missing notification does not cancel an existing task; only authoritative run state establishes its outcome.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
